entities.title: outline reads, and indexes, files outside the root
entities.summary: outline passes the agent's path to RootIndex.Freshen without Root.Resolve, so a path like ../x or an absolute path is read, analysed and added to the root's file list.
entities.expected: A path outside the root is refused with outside_root, as read does, following the rule in macos/dotnet/style.md: resolve every agent-supplied path through Root.Resolve.
entities.observed: OutlineTool.Run only uses Root.Resolve to test for a directory; OutlineFile calls Freshen(rel), whose Analyze combines the root with rel, reads any existing file, stores its blob, adds a file record under the escaping path and logs it as added, until the next reconcile removes it. The outline (declarations and signatures) of that file is returned.
acceptanceCriteria: outline of ../x and of an absolute path returns outside_root and leaves the index unchanged, with a test like test_read_rejects_escape.

origin.description: Found while documenting the folder, by reading OutlineTool and RootIndex.Analyze; not reproduced.

entities.title: git_log and git_blame do not resolve paths
entities.summary: The path argument is passed to git after the root name is split off, without Root.Resolve.
entities.expected: A path outside the root is refused with outside_root, following macos/dotnet/style.md.
entities.observed: GitLogTool.Run and GitBlameTool.Run pass the relative path straight to git -C <root>; when the root is a subdirectory of its repository, ../ paths answer for files elsewhere in the repository, and other escapes surface as git_failed.
acceptanceCriteria: Both tools resolve their path through Root.Resolve, with a test.

origin.description: Found while documenting the folder, by reading GitTools.cs against macos/dotnet/style.md; not reproduced.

entities.title: An index_cold answer does not say so
entities.summary: When the index is still building, search and find_files answer from a plain scan and log scan / index_cold, but the answer itself carries no label.
entities.expected: The README's How it works section said fallbacks are labelled "in the log and the answer"; an agent should be able to tell a cold-index answer apart.
entities.observed: Root.Listing and SearchTool.Candidates set CallInfo.Path and Reason only; the footers of search and find_files are the same as for an indexed answer. The external regex fallback and run do label their answers.
acceptanceCriteria: search and find_files answered while the index is cold say so in their footer, or the README no longer claims it.

origin.description: Found while documenting the folder, by reading the tools against the README; not reproduced.

entities.title: overview logs one file too few per root
entities.summary: OverviewTool adds each root's file count to CallInfo.TotalFiles, which starts at -1.
entities.expected: The usage log's files field for an overview call equals the number of files described.
entities.observed: It is the count minus one (for one root), because CallInfo.TotalFiles defaults to -1 and Describe adds to it.
acceptanceCriteria: The files field of an overview record equals the total number of files over the selected roots.

origin.description: Found while documenting the folder, by reading OverviewTool.Describe and CallInfo; not reproduced.
